authority: P1D.0 — draft for user review. NOT frozen. No gate closed.
description: Maps each of the 11 frozen benchmark slices to one or more of the six P1D task families. This mapping is REQUIRED because the benchmark was authored around adversarial retrieval-failure MODES (slices), not product WORKFLOWS (task families) — there is no 1:1 correspondence. A case may map to multiple families. This artifact is what lets P1D.1 classify the 66 cases by task family and what makes the task-family framing usable at all.

lexical_trap.mapping_rationale: Lexical traps (high token overlap, wrong meaning) primarily threaten agenda matching: a result that shares tokens but studies a different thing. They also threaten paper discovery (irrelevant paper retrieved) and, when the trap mimics evidence, false support in evidence retrieval.
lexical_trap.example_cases: ml_lt_001_c 'Optimizing Network Routing with Descent Algorithms' (network routing, not gradient descent); bio_lt_001_c 'Resistance Welding of Drug-Eluting Stents' (manufacturing, not drug resistance).
lexical_trap.coverage: All 6 lexical_trap cases (3 disc + 3 ret) map here.

semantic_paraphrase.mapping_rationale: Paraphrase cases test whether the system retrieves relevant results that DON'T share exact terms. This is the core semantic-generalization use case for paper discovery and evidence retrieval. Agenda-mismatch is secondary (a paraphrase can still mismatch on agenda).
semantic_paraphrase.example_cases: ml_sp_001_a 'Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Training' (ZeRO) for query 'efficiently training very large language models'.

method_vs_application.mapping_rationale: This slice is the DIRECT proxy for method retrieval: it tests whether a method paper ranks above an application of that method. The cleanest 1:1 mapping in the benchmark.
method_vs_application.example_cases: ml_mv_001_a 'Masked Autoencoders' (method) vs ml_mv_001_b 'Applying Self-Supervised Features to Medical Image Classification' (application).

review_vs_primary.mapping_rationale: Review-vs-primary distinguishes a primary study (direct evidence) from a review (synthesis). For evidence retrieval, the primary is what's wanted; for multi-paper synthesis, the review is itself a target but must not crowd out primaries. Tests evidence-granularity-adjacent discrimination.
review_vs_primary.example_cases: bio_rv_001_a 'Semaglutide SELECT Trial' (primary) vs bio_rv_001_b 'GLP-1 Systematic Review' (review).

missing_abstract.mapping_rationale: Missing-abstract cases test ranking when the evidential text is absent — the system must rely on title + domain context. Primary relevance to discovery (can we still find the paper?) and evidence retrieval (can we confirm evidence without the abstract?).
missing_abstract.example_cases: ml_ma_001_b 'Score-Based Generative Modeling Through SDEs' (empty abstract).

near_duplicate.mapping_rationale: Near-duplicate cases test that redundant results don't dominate — the DIRECT proxy for the multi_paper_synthesis redundancy risk. The only slice that directly exercises a diversity-adjacent property.
near_duplicate.example_cases: ml_nd_001_b/b2 near-duplicates of the ViT paper.
near_duplicate.coverage: All 6 near_duplicate cases map here. Note: tests non-domination, NOT diversity-as-a-goal.

source_rank_conflict.mapping_rationale: Source-rank-conflict cases insert a high-source-priority but irrelevant result (e.g., a Nature editorial on an unrelated topic). Tests whether source authority overrides relevance — central to agenda matching and evidence-retrieval precision.
source_rank_conflict.example_cases: ml_sr_001_b 'A Non-Relevant Nature Perspective on AI Funding' for query 'state space models for long sequences'.

acronym_vs_expanded.mapping_rationale: Acronym-collision cases (e.g., ADC = antibody-drug conjugate vs analog-to-digital converter) are a specialized lexical trap that primarily threatens agenda matching and discovery precision.
acronym_vs_expanded.example_cases: bio_ac_001_c 'Analog-to-Digital Converter Circuit Design' for query 'ADC antibody-drug conjugates'.

negated_findings.mapping_rationale: The ONLY slice that proxies contradiction retrieval: cases include negated/contradicting results that must be surfaced. The benchmark grades these as highly relevant (grade 3), which captures surface relevance but NOT the 'am I missing a contradicting result' workflow — see evidence-limitation note.
negated_findings.example_cases: bio_nf_001_b 'Metformin Shows No Effect on Cancer in the MICE Trial' (negated result, grade 3).
negated_findings.coverage: All 6 negated_findings cases map here. WEAK PROXY for contradiction_retrieval — flagged in need spec.

exact_identifier.mapping_rationale: Exact-identifier cases (query is a named entity like 'ResNet', 'AlphaFold', 'GPT-3') test precise entity retrieval and disambiguation — relevant to discovery and to confirming the exact intended target (agenda).
exact_identifier.example_cases: bio_ei_001_a 'AlphaFold: Highly Accurate Protein Structure Prediction'.

neutral.mapping_rationale: Neutral cases are non-adversarial baselines — straightforward topical relevance without a trap. Primary fit is paper discovery; some are method-flavored.
neutral.example_cases: ml_nt_001 'image segmentation with transformers' (SAM, Mask2Former, U-Net, DETR).

task_family_coverage_from_existing_bench.description: How well each task family is covered by the existing 66 cases, via the slice mapping above. This is the key input to deciding whether P1D.2's fresh cases are load-bearing.

paper_discovery.note: The benchmark is essentially a discovery benchmark. Near-complete coverage.

method_retrieval.note: method_vs_application is a direct proxy. Reasonable but not exhaustive.

research_gap_analysis.note: Agenda mismatch is emergent across slices, not directly measured. No PICO-discriminating cases.

multi_paper_synthesis.note: Only tests non-domination. Diversity-as-a-goal is NOT measured. No multi-paper coverage metric exists.

evidence_retrieval.note: Operates at title+abstract granularity, NOT passage granularity. Cannot validate the actual evidence-retrieval workflow.

contradiction_retrieval.note: Only 6 cases, and they measure surface relevance of negated results, NOT the missed-contradiction workflow. Weakest coverage of any family.

task_family_coverage_from_existing_bench.headline_finding: Three of six task families (multi_paper_synthesis, evidence_retrieval, contradiction_retrieval) are weakly or minimally covered by the existing benchmark. This is structural evidence that P1D.2 (fresh product-grounded cases) is load-bearing, not optional — documented in p1d_failure_analysis.md.
